feeds.title: Polyamory in the News
feeds.description: Tracking the coverage of polyamory in the media since 2005, plus ongoing news of the poly movement.

feeds.title: Psychology Today » The Polyamorists Next Door
feeds.description: Using empirical information based in academic research, this blog explores the issues facing polyamorous relationships and families. It covers topics as diverse as sexuality to parenting, jealousy to coming out to families of origin, and employment and housing discrimination to online dating.

feeds.title: Ready For Polyamory
feeds.description: Ready for Polyamory offers education, personal stories, and relationship advice on polyamory, relationship anarchy, and alternative relationships. I'm Laura. I've been in ethically non-monogamous relationships for twelve years now, and I found the word polyamory eight years ago and realized it was a great fit for my attitude toward relationships.

feeds.title: The Polyamorous Librarian
feeds.description: Alana Phelan is a bisexual, polyamorous author from Southern New Jersey. She is an actual librarian, public speaker, and relationship support coach. Here, you can read about books and her lifestyle stories.

feeds.title: Minka Guides
feeds.description: A lifestyle blog for everyone who questions the norm. From polyamorous relationships and personal growth to queer travel adventures, Minka Guides helps you live a fabulous life with intentionality.

feeds.title: Redefining Love
feeds.description: A blog about polyamory, non-monogamy, and open marriage. The author shares her thoughts on Marriage, Polyamory, Kids, Friends, Attachment, Jealousy, and Online Dating.

feeds.title: Journey Into The Grey
feeds.description: Follow us on our journey with mental health and a Poly Relationship. The author will discuss day-to-day struggles in life and their polyamory relationship.

feeds.title: The Adventures of a Black Poly Babe
feeds.description: Jai is big on learning & growing, who likes to read books & magazine articles. Here, she compiles a list of articles, podcasts, and other forms of media that directly represent black & brown polyamorous people.

feeds.title: Poly With a Big Heart
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Rusty. I'm polyamorous, and a relationship anarchist! I categorize my approach to polyamory as egalitarian (meaning I do not practice hierarchy) with a heavy lean towards solo poly (meaning I prioritize autonomy over interdependence).
